LESSON: MASS, VOLUME, WEIGHT AND DENSITY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements 3.2 Volume of Solids (8 lessons) • Volume of triangular and rectang
Topic 3.3: Mass, Volume, Weight and Density
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mass, Volume, Weight and Density, part of Measurements 3.2 Volume of Solids (8 lessons) • Volume of triangular and rectang in Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do you weigh materials and objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Mass, Volume, Weight and Density together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: learner discusses the relationship between mass and weight.

● Creativity and Imagination: learner determines the density of different materials or objects.

● Digital Literacy: as the learner uses IT devices to determine the mass, volume and density of different objects.

Values:
● Integrity: learner gives correct masses and weights of different materials and objects.

● Responsibility: learner works and takes care of weighing machines and other resources.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Education for Sustainable Development (ESD): careers in business such as shopkeeping where weighing tools are used.

● Self-awareness: learner weighs themselves for health purposes.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Integrated Science: learner uses machines and tools that involve weighing different substances.
